The keys the player must press are: D, A, A#, G, and C# (2nd white key, 6th white key, 5th black key, 5th white key, and the 1st black key).
After playing the final note, the player will then be teleported to a dark area that infinitely spawns
Undead Heads and
Undead Eyes. This area contains nine coffins in a square grid around the player, which can be seen on the map.
One of these coffins contains

Avatar Infernas (enemy), while the rest are empty, and is randomized in each run. After opening the coffin containing Avatar Infernas, the darkness will fade, all of the remaining enemies disappear, and the now hostile Avatar Infernas will spawn and slowly chase the player. Defeating the hostile Avatar Infernas unlocks him as a playable character and causes the
White Hand to appear and end the run.

If the player has high enough speed or low enough framerate, it is possible for this character to clip through walls. This is because when the player moves the game does not check between the player's location and the target destination, instead simply moving the player, checking if the player is in a wall, and if so pushing them back. This phenomenon is most observable in Avatar Infernas due to his infinite potential speed.
